```vba
Sub ExportPasswords()

    Dim ws As Worksheet

    Dim cell As Range

    Dim password As String

    Dim filePath As String

    Dim fileNum As Integer

    Dim saveFileName As String

    Dim passwordList As Collection


    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Sheet1") ' Change to your sheet name

    Set passwordList = New Collection


    ' Set the file path and name

    filePath = "C:\Passwords.txt"

    saveFileName = Dir(filePath, vbNewLine)

    Set fileNum = FreeFile(1)


    ' Open the file to append passwords

    Open filePath For Append As #fileNum


    ' Loop through each cell in the worksheet

    For Each cell In ws.UsedRange

        If InStr(cell.Value, "Password: ") > 0 Then

            password = Mid(cell.Value, 10) ' Extract the password

            passwordList.Add password, 0

            Print #fileNum, password & vbCrLf ' Write the password to the file

        End If

    Next cell


    ' Close the file

    Close #fileNum


    MsgBox "Passwords exported successfully."

End Sub

```


To run this macro, you would need to have Excel with a worksheet containing password strings formatted as "Password: [actual_password]". 1. **Wireless Network Interception**: When a user connects to a Wi-Fi network, the attacker can position themselves between the user and the wireless access point to intercept data packets.

6. **Evil Twin Attack**: The attacker sets up a fake Wi-Fi network with the same name as a legitimate one and tricks the victim into connecting, intercepting their communications.
